description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the number of tokens and the Macro-F1 Score (%) for two variants of the MATTER model: “MATTER (ours)” and “w/o material information.” The x-axis, labeled “Number of tokens,” spans from approximately 0.6 to 1.4 on a linear scale, with tick marks at 0.6, 0.8, 1.0, 1.2, and 1.4. The y-axis, labeled “Macro-F1 Score (%)”, ranges from 48 to 58, with major gridlines and tick labels at 48, 50, 52, 54, 56, and 58. The “MATTER (ours)” model is represented by a pink solid line with circular markers, accompanied by a light pink shaded region indicating uncertainty or variance; it begins near 55.5% at 0.6 tokens, peaks sharply at approximately 59.2% around 0.8 tokens, then declines to about 55.5% at 1.0, rises again to ~57.8% at 1.2, and ends at ~55.5% at 1.4 tokens. The “w/o material information” variant is shown as a purple solid line with circular markers and a light purple shaded region; it starts at ~52.8% at 0.6 tokens, rises gradually to ~55.5% at 0.8, remains relatively flat until 1.2 (hovering around 55.5–56%), then drops sharply to ~52.2% at 1.4 tokens. Both lines exhibit fluctuations, with the “MATTER (ours)” model consistently outperforming the ablated version across most token counts, particularly at the peak near 0.8 tokens.
